notes.title: Related: Ace Attorney Investigations Collection is available now!
notes.notes:
Ace Attorney Investigations Collection is available now! Join prodigious prosecutor Miles Edgeworth as he pursues the truth at any cost in two beautifully remastered games, complete with redesigned chibi character sprites, an array of special content and features, and the Western debut of Ace Attorney Investigations 2: Prosecutor's Gambit. 

A demo is also available to download on Steam. Step out of the courtroom to investigate crime scenes and deduce facts in the first half of the first case of each game in the collection.

notes.title: Apollo's journey begins anew!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=YwULOH1QyAE;full][/previewyoutube]
If it please the court, we have new evidence to submit about the lawyers, friends, and rivals of the Wright Anything Agency across all three games included in Apollo Justice: Ace Attorney Trilogy!

Check the Court Record, and you'll see this collection is packed with a gallery, music player, cutscene viewer, and previously released DLC. Join Apollo Justice, Phoenix Wright, Athena Cykes, and a colorful cast of friends and foes as Apollo puts an end to the Dark Age of the Law!
Check out the previous title in the series, Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Trilogy, now on sale for a limited time.
